parsing_rationale: The document is a functional specification for a Sales Item Management system. I have mapped the User Stories to 'Functional Requirements' as they define the core behavior. The 'Functional Requirements' section was mapped directly. 'Assumptions' and 'Edge Cases' were parsed into constraints and requirements. I identified a significant structural gap regarding 'Goals & Objectives' and 'Non-Functional Requirements' (though some success criteria touch upon it, a dedicated section is missing). The 'Persistence' ambiguity was captured as an open question.

project_info.brief_explanation: A front-end application (HTML/CSS/JS) to browse and manage a catalog of items for sale with a modern, responsive design.
project_info.source_context: User request for a dynamic and interactive site for managing items to sell.

sections.title: Feature Specification: Sales Item Management System
sections.raw_content:
**Feature Branch**: `001-sales-item-management`

**Created**: 2026-08-12

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "je veux créer projet de gestion d'article à vendre avec page HTML ,design CSS moderne et en utilisant JS pour des scripts pour mettre site dynamique et interactive"

sections.title: User Story 1 - View and Browse Items (Priority: P1)
sections.raw_content:
As a visitor, I want to see a list of items available for sale so that I can find products that interest me.

**Why this priority**: This is the core value of the site; without a way to view items, the site has no purpose.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by loading the home page and verifying that a list of items is displayed with their details.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:
1. **Given** the home page is loaded, **When** I browse the list, **Then** I should see the item name, price, and an image for each product.
2. **Given** a list of items, **When** I use a filter or search bar, **Then** the list should update dynamically to show only matching items.

---

sections.title: User Story 2 - Manage Items (Add/Edit/Delete) (Priority: P1)
sections.raw_content:
As an administrator, I want to add, edit, and delete items from the catalog so that the inventory remains up-to-date.

**Why this priority**: Essential for the "management" aspect of the project.

**Independent Test**: Can be tested by accessing the management area and performing CRUD operations on a test item.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:
1. **Given** the management page, **When** I fill out the "Add Item" form and submit, **Then** the item should be added to the catalog.
2. **Given** an existing item, **When** I click "Edit" and change the price, **Then** the updated price should be reflected in the catalog.
3. **Given** an existing item, **When** I click "Delete", **Then** the item should be removed from the catalog.

---

sections.title: User Story 3 - Interactive Item Details (Priority: P2)
sections.raw_content:
As a visitor, I want to click on an item to see more details or a larger image so that I can make an informed purchase decision.

**Why this priority**: Enhances user experience and provides necessary information for conversion.

**Independent Test**: Can be tested by clicking an item card and verifying that a modal or a detailed view opens.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:
1. **Given** an item card, **When** I click on it, **Then** a modal should open showing a detailed description and a larger image of the item.
2. **Given** an open modal, **When** I click the close button, **Then** the modal should close and return me to the item list.

---

sections.title: Edge Cases
sections.raw_content:
- **Empty Catalog**: What happens when no items are available? The system should display a "No items found" message.
- **Invalid Input**: How does the system handle negative prices or empty item names in the management form? The system should prevent submission and show validation errors.
- **Persistence**: Since this is a front-end project, how is data stored? [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: Should data be persisted in LocalStorage, or is a mock API/JSON file expected for this stage?]

sections.title: Functional Requirements
sections.raw_content:
- **FR-001**: System MUST display a gallery of items for sale.
- **FR-002**: System MUST allow users to filter items by category or search by name.
- **FR-003**: System MUST provide a form to add new items to the catalog.
- **FR-004**: System MUST allow editing of existing item details.
- **FR-005**: System MUST allow deletion of items from the catalog.
- **FR-006**: System MUST display item details in an interactive modal.
- **FR-007**: System MUST validate form inputs (e.g., price must be a positive number).
- **FR-008**: System MUST persist item data across page reloads [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: LocalStorage vs Mock API].

sections.title: Success Criteria
sections.raw_content:
- **Measurable**: Users can add a new item to the catalog in under 30 seconds.
- **Technology-Agnostic**: The interface is fully responsive and usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- **User-Focused**: 100% of items in the catalog are displayed with a consistent layout.
- **Verifiable**: All CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) are functional and verified.

sections.title: Key Entities
sections.raw_content:
- **Item**:
    - ID (Unique identifier)
    - Name (String)
    - Description (String)
    - Price (Number)
    - Category (String)
    - ImageURL (String)

sections.title: Assumptions
sections.raw_content:
- The project is a client-side implementation (HTML/CSS/JS).
- "Modern design" implies a clean, minimalist aesthetic with a responsive layout.
- The "management" part is handled via a simple admin interface on the same site.
